budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants for the period 8/5 to 8/22 were reported as signed, with no line item transfers.
budget_items.quote: 8/5 to 8/22 $463,413.80 no line item transfers, warrants have been signed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recommended capital items with dollar amounts were listed in priority order and the ranking was accepted; the list includes driveway, playground, hot water tank, generator and safety film items.
A 1-year paraprofessional agreement, reviewed by the town manager, includes a 4% raise.
Chapter 90 funds were described as $2.4 million, with $1.6 million left after current work is paid off; the sidewalk project will be funded from it.
budget_items.quote: mr. bernard was there to explain chapter 90 funding, currently they have $2.4 million dollars

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager selection committee was given $15,000 from the reserve account to fund a recruiting firm.

budget_items.topic: Funding formula and state aid cap
